feedback.problem: In degrees, find the general solution to the equation $\operatorname{tan}⁡x=-\sqrt{3}.$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the principal value:

$$
{x}_{1}=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(-\sqrt{3})=-{60}^{∘}
$$

The tangent function has a period of ${180}^{∘}.$  Hence, the general solution for the given equation is

$$
x=-{60}^{∘}+n\cdot {180}^{∘}.
$$
